text:
A 2,600 sq ft flat on Nepean Sea Road. Rent: about ₹1,300 a month, where market rent was over ₹1 lakh (Bloomberg, 2012, converted at the 2012 rate).

Why? Bombay's 1947 rent law froze rents at 1940 levels. Landlords stopped repairing. But when the building was redeveloped, the tenants got about ₹14 crore to move.

So is that the cheapest rent in India, or the most valuable lease? #Mumbai
